changes.to: Maker page: 1,300 mm height, 34 kg, 23 DOF (5 per arm, 6 per leg, 1 waist), max arm payload 3 kg, DYNAMIXEL Q actuators (QM-060 x 14, QM-080 x 9), Jetson Orin NX 16GB (up to 100 sparse INT8 TOPS), 46.8 V 9,000 mAh battery (=421.2 Wh, derived from V x Ah), Wi-Fi 5 + Bluetooth 5.0, 2 Ethernet, USB 2.0 x 2 and USB 3.0 x 2, 24 V/10 A and 12 V/10 A power outputs. Sold as a development platform, not a finished product: DYNAMIXEL-Q and the open-source release (BoM, STEP files, code, simulation, tutorials) were still being rolled out, so status is Announced. Max speed, runtime and a sensor list are not published.
Open-source stack: hardware BoM, STEP CAD, source code, simulation assets, tutorials (ROS 2)
K0 is the first open-source humanoid of ROBOTIS' AI Sapiens line: a 1.3 m, 23-DOF platform on in-house DYNAMIXEL-Q quasi-direct-drive actuators for learning-based locomotion and manipulation.
